captions.text: Waste is billed by weight, but only the operator weighs it, after pickup.
Our demo hotel group: 395 pickups a year, only 48 with a weighing ticket.
The machine knows how full it is. Nobody knows how heavy.

scenes.what: 1 · Inside the machine: it opens up, the hydraulic ram is visible.
2 · Sensors already on board (no oil probe); load cells only as 'SMART Scale option · reference machines only'.
3 · Every push draws a pressure graph; 23–94 % full: fuller pushes back harder.
4 · Hourly message BIN-0001, 16 Mar 2026 16:00: 62 %, 2 presses, 112 bar, graph, GPS; weather −3.9 °C, 78 %, no rain (FMI in production · synthetic here).
5 · Model: error 32.1 % → 5.3 % as signals are added; example ≈ 1,490 kg (1,370–1,530) vs 1,451 kg true (simulated).
6 · Reassembles with '≈ 1,490 kg inside' badge: no extra hardware on SMART machines.
Honesty card: Simulated data · internals schematic · real-weight test next.

captions.text: Inside every Europress compactor, a hydraulic ram presses each load.
The sensors are already on board. Every push draws a pressure graph: fuller pushes back harder.
Every hour it reaches the SMART cloud, with local weather.
Fill alone is 32 % off; our model, 5.3 % on machines it never saw.
No extra hardware. Simulated today; real weights next.

shots.what: Customer overview on SMART Free (weight locked) → click SMART: live container weight 5.8 t, ≈ 2,849 kg inside now.
Weight page: Mixed waste 2 weight now and expected charge → machine page: most likely range, next pickup, expected charge.
How to save money: click the €39,955 'empty when full' lever → trace drawer with formula and data rows.
Switch to Partner view (Hauler Alpha): driver plan 14 days ahead, 'call in more drivers' → How SMART creates value: 676 fewer trips → The partnership.
Switch to Europress view → weight soft sensor, Weighbridge check, New installations.
Sales pipeline: open Hospitality Customer 0049 → 'Brief me' → Claude brief (cached real answer, brief_cache_v2.sse).

captions.text: On SMART Free, a customer sees fill levels. Switch to SMART, and every container shows its weight.
Each machine shows its weight now, at the next pickup, and the expected charge, before the truck comes.
SMART AI found €52,154 a year, 37 % of this customer's cost. Every euro opens to its formula and data rows.
Operators are partners. They get a driver plan two weeks ahead; Hauler Alpha drives 676 fewer trips a year. In return, they share pickups and weights through SMART.
Europress checks the model against partners' weighbridge weights, pickup by pickup.
Sales start with the biggest savers, with a brief Claude writes from cited data.
SMART is paid with a share of what it saves: this hotel group pays about €13,000 and keeps €39,000.
Across the demo fleet: €1.25 million saved for 52 customers, 3,945 fewer truck trips, and about €311,000 a year for Europress.
Next: weigh a small reference group for real, retrain, and ship it to every machine as software.
Europress sells trust and control, never data.
